event.name: Rio Grande do Sul flood observation context

candidate_question: Do the closely timed NASA optical classifications and diagnostic Sentinel-1-derived backscatter measurements support a water-related explanation at this AOI?
summary: This case is a diagnostic Sentinel-1-derived OPERA RTC-S1 comparison linked to NASA DSWx-HLS observations within about a day of each SAR acquisition. QA remains unresolved; the datasets are not pixel matched and do not establish cause or flood extent.
